preflightchecklist.title: Preflight — N172ME

items.label: Seats, belts, doors — adjusted and locked
Fuel quantity — CHECK visually, both tanks
Flight controls — free and correct movement
Flight instruments — set, altimeter to field elevation
Doors and windows — closed and latched
Run-up — magnetos checked, max 150 RPM drop
Engine gauges — in the green arc
Fuel — monitor both tanks, switch as needed
Altitude — maintain assigned or cruise altitude

preflightchecklist.footer: IMSAFE check clear, weight and balance within limits, fuel for the leg plus reserve.
